title: White Ducks in Shaded Backyard Garden, 1965 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot photograph taken in September 1965 featuring two white ducks or geese resting in the dappled sunlight and shade under a tree. In the background, lush potted plants and garden foliage sit outside a home with a multi-pane window and porch overhang, alongside a metal basin filled with water. The image reflects peaceful mid-century American suburban or country domestic life.
